title: Plant
short_explanation: A plant is a living thing that grows in soil and needs sunlight, water, and air.

title: Root
short_explanation: Roots hold the plant in the soil and take in water.

title: Stem
short_explanation: The stem carries water from the roots to the rest of the plant.

title: Leaf
short_explanation: Leaves help the plant make food using sunlight.

title: Flower
short_explanation: Flowers help the plant make seeds and new plants.

title: Fruit
short_explanation: Fruit protects the seeds inside it.

title: Seed
short_explanation: A seed can grow into a new plant.

title: Water
short_explanation: Plants need water to grow and stay healthy.

title: Sunlight
short_explanation: Plants use sunlight to make their own food.
